ns2:course.label: History & Theory of Modern Landscape Architecture
ns2:course.description: A selected overview of developments in landscape architecture in the western world from 1900 to the present. Same as ARCH 515. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: LA 513 or approval of instructor.
